message.zh-CN: git 子命令拼写错误：comit 应为 commit。
message.en: Git subcommand typo: comit should be commit.

hint.zh-CN: git commit -m "message" 才是提交；可以输入 git help 查看用法。
hint.en: Use git commit -m "message"; run git help for usage.

message.zh-CN: git 子命令拼写错误：chekcout 应为 checkout（或 switch）。
message.en: Git subcommand typo: chekcout should be checkout (or switch).

hint.zh-CN: 切换分支推荐 git switch <branch>，恢复文件用 git restore。
hint.en: Prefer git switch <branch> for branches and git restore for files.

message.zh-CN: 强制推送会改写远端历史，可能覆盖他人提交。
message.en: Force pushing rewrites remote history and may overwrite others' commits.

hint.zh-CN: 共享分支上尽量避免强推；必要时用 --force-with-lease 并先通知协作者。
hint.en: Avoid force pushing shared branches; if required, use --force-with-lease and notify collaborators.

message.zh-CN: reset --hard 会丢弃工作区和暂存区的未提交改动。
message.en: reset --hard discards uncommitted working-tree and staged changes.

hint.zh-CN: 先 git stash 或 git diff 确认没有要保留的改动；已推送的提交优先用 git revert。
hint.en: Stash or diff first; prefer git revert for commits already pushed.

message.zh-CN: git commit 不带 -m 会打开编辑器；脚本中务必提供提交信息。
message.en: git commit without -m opens an editor; always supply a message in scripts.

hint.zh-CN: 写成 git commit -m "<type>: <what changed>" 更清晰。
hint.en: Write git commit -m "<type>: <what changed>" for clarity.
